reviews.title: Best habit app, hands-down
reviews.text: I’ve tried a lot of different apps + paper strategies over the years to track habits, and this app has been the best by a mile. It’s easy to set up and stick with, enjoyable to use and visually beautiful, flexible to my needs while keeping me accountable. One underrated excellent feature is that they give you fine-tuned control over the notifications you receive — probably the #1 reason I’ve deleted other habit apps was that they spammed me with a billion distracting notifications, but Not Boring doesn’t create this issue. Price is perfectly reasonable/well worth it. There’s only one minor feature I’d like them to add: I’d love if I could toggle on a “don’t skip 2” option in the settings - I.e. make it so that streaks are only considered “broken” if you miss 2 instances. But otherwise literally perfect.

reviews.title: Beautiful! One suggestion
reviews.text: Very useful app for habit building. I keep wanting to see my progression in a “calendar” view more easily. Having to scroll through the “banner” at the bottom is a bit hard with the area being so small. I’d love a swipe-screen option. Also, it’d be useful to have an aggregate view with all my progressions across all habits. And to be able to access the specific habits more easily in the top of the app. Sometimes the swipes don’t respond as it’s quite a reach to get to the top of the phone and swipe in a small area. These are minor suggestions and the app has a Wonderful design!! Great music, haptics, and graphic design. This app is made with a ton of passion, and I enjoy using it and have a ton of appreciation for it. Thank you!

reviews.title: Beautiful, but bad UX
reviews.text:
For the most part, I really like this app. There's no ads and the developers don't collect your data. The app is habit tracking in its simplest form. You just open the app and hold the button, no fluff. 

The sounds and haptics are great, giving you a small dose of dopamine every time you check something off. 

I have a handful of issues, though. First is there's a tight character limit on each habit. I found it hard to squeeze some of my habits in.

Second is I don't care for the cryptic messages you get with every check. Wish I could disable those.

Third and most importantly, the user experience is cumbersome. You have to swipe one at a time through every habit. At the end of every day, when I want to restart back at habit one, I have to swipe through 16 habits. That alone is enough for me to not want to use this app anymore.

Then you have the fact that every time you swipe to a different habit, it brings you back to the checkmark screen. So if I want to look at the calendar view for my habits, I have to swipe up twice to get to the calendar, swipe left to go to the next habit, swipe up twice to again get to the calendar, swipe left to go to the next habit, etc...

The worst part about this is, these issues aren't readily apparent from the free version when you only have two habits to look at. 

Finally, this is personal taste, but I don't like a single one of 10 skins you get with premium, which was a bummer.
